products.title: SIGNAL / 01
products.short: Dark contours. A warm orange focal point.
products.lead: Make room for your next idea.
products.description: SIGNAL / 01 combines a charcoal background, flowing contour lines and a warm orange focal point. The artwork sits mainly to the right and along the lower edge, leaving a quieter center for your keyboard and everyday work.
products.artAlt: SIGNAL / 01: charcoal artwork with pale contour lines and an orange circle.
products.artNote: An original graphic composition. The contours are artwork, not a measured acoustic signal.

products.title: SUBSURFACE / 02
products.lead: A different perspective for your everyday workspace.
products.description: SUBSURFACE / 02 pairs a warm off-white background with an abstract architectural grid and an orange contour. The open center keeps the composition calm, while the geometry gives the right side a distinct visual focus.
products.artAlt: SUBSURFACE / 02: warm off-white artwork with a gray architectural grid and orange accents.
products.artNote: An original imagined surface, not a geographical map. The geometry is decorative artwork.
